title: Prime Minister congratulates Nithya Sre Sumathy Sivan on winning Silver at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Nithya Sre Sumathy Sivan on winning Silver in Women’s Singles SH6 at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that moving from winning the Bronze in the previous edition to Silver this time is a wonderful achievement, expressing hope that she continues to shine and bring more laurels to the country. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "Congratulations to Nithya Sre Sumathy Sivan on winning Silver in Women’s Singles SH6 at the Asian Para Games! From winning the Bronze in the previous edition to Silver this time is a wonderful achievement. May she continue to shine and bring more laurels to the country: PM @narendramodi" Congratulations to Nithya Sre Sumathy Sivan on winning Silver in Women’s Singles SH6 at the Asian Para Games!
